Self.Wiki: An item pickup. The treasure places the items of its item lot as a glowing pickup at the treasure part, such as an item corpse or a chest. Taking it awards the lot and sets the lot's Get Item Flag, after which the pickup no longer appears.

TreasurePartName.Wiki: The part the pickup is placed at, normally an Object (item corpse, chest). With no part, no pickup appears.

ItemLotID.Wiki: The ItemLotParam row given by the treasure.

ActionButtonID.Wiki: An ActionButtonParam row for the pickup prompt, or -1 for the default. Retail sets it on a few treasures, mostly 4210.

PickupAnimID.Wiki: The player animation played when taking the pickup, or -1 for the normal one. -1 on every retail treasure.

InChest.Wiki: If ON, the item is inside a chest. 19 retail treasures use it.

StartDisabled.Wiki: If ON, the pickup is placed hidden and can't be taken until something enables it. Turn it off for items that should be available at once.
